_comment: Books on inner-map bookshelves (systems/books.js). A shelf offers the unread books its place could hold (tier: village 1, town 2, capital/temple/library 3); each reading advances the open book by one sitting (two sittings a day count at most); finishing it grants its reward once. Rewards: skills (capped at 10), stats (capped by devotion's statCaps.intelligence share via Devotion.raiseStat), knowledge (an extinct faith discovered, tiles revealed around the reader).

libraries._doc: A seat's own library (systems/library.js; founded by player/startKnowledge.js for the advanced starts). Its books are written from the world when it is founded (the realm's chronicle, the royal roll, maps, the faith's annals, the guild's rolls) and come first at a shelf inside one of the seat's buildings; each sitting reads out pagesPerSitting pages (sittings between minSittings and maxSittings). neighbours: how many neighbouring realms the royal library has maps and letters of.

books.title: The Art of Command
books.author: Marshal Edric Vane
books.finish: You close Vane's book with a new eye for the line of a battle.

books.title: The Ledgers of Merathis
books.author: a nameless factor
books.finish: Credit, carriage, margin — the factor's ledgers finally make sense.

books.title: A Duellist's Almanac
books.author: Ser Hollis the Lame
books.finish: Hollis lost his leg learning what he wrote down. You keep both of yours.

books.title: Letters of an Envoy
books.author: Countess Ysolde Marr
books.finish: Every letter is a negotiation. You have learned to read between the lines.

books.title: Primer of the Cant
books.author: unsigned
books.finish: The chalk marks on the town walls speak to you now.

books.title: Of Roads and Rivers
books.author: Wenna the Surveyor
books.finish: Wenna's descriptions fit the land around you; you could draw it from memory.

books.title: Commentaries on the Old Laws
books.author: Magister Aubrecht
books.finish: Dry as dust, and worth every hour. Your mind is keener for it.

books.title: A Book of Hours
books.author: the sisters of an unnamed abbey
books.finish: The little prayers for every hour stay with you.

books.title: Engines of the Siege
books.author: Durheim master-engineer Gorm
books.finish: You understand now why walls fall, and when they don't.

books.title: Chronicle of the Kings
books.author: court historians
books.finish: Every dynasty you know of rose and fell in these pages. Yours too, someday.

books.title: The Ash Hymnal
books.author: unknown
books.finish: The hymnal belongs to a faith no one prays to any more: the Ashwalkers.

books.title: Songs of the Bonesingers
books.author: transcribed by a travelling monk
books.finish: The songs are a liturgy: the lost rites of the Bonesingers.

books.title: The Physician's Herbal
books.author: Mother Gilla
books.finish: You can tell feverfew from hemlock, and the price of each.

books.title: A Rutter of the Western Sea
books.author: Captain Ilse Drummond
books.finish: Soundings, currents and landmarks: Drummond's rutter is a map in words.
